items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a locally of finite type morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and an integer n at least 0, the set W_n of points x of |X| where the relative dimension of f at x is at most n is open (source lines 7004-7015). The proof chooses a presentation diagram with U, V schemes and surjective etale vertical arrows, applies the scheme case to h : U -> V to see that the corresponding set U_n is open in U, identifies U_n with the preimage of W_n under the etale map a using the chapter's definition of relative dimension at a point of an algebraic space, and concludes openness of W_n from the definition of the topology on |X|.
